## Pipeline Velocity Bottleneck Detection v1.1
Schedule: Fridays 8 AM  
Output: Slack digest
- Query HubSpot → Get all open deals
- Calculate → Days-in-stage for each deal
- Classify → HIGH/MEDIUM/OK risk
- Quantify → Revenue at risk
- Stage Bottleneck Analysis (slowest/fastest stages)
- Auto-updating config Sheet

## Read & Extract Data
Gets all open deals from HubSpot every Friday at 8am

## Calculate & Aggregate Data
- Calculates deals at risk based on SLAs
- Calculates revenue at risk
- Aggregates deals at risk by stage and identifies highest risk deals
- Calculates trends vs. last week
- Calculates stage stats to identify bottlenecks in sales cycle
- Merges results for Slack digest

## Read & Update Data
Reads and maintains database for trend calculation

## Distribute Data
Sends summary to Slack Channel
